mechanism: Source-blind learned binding of four nibble-sized variables using a reversible 4-position permutation, four local affine nibble transforms, and one gated reversible cross-variable XOR relation. This is a new representation, NOT a tuned BQ/BX shear and NOT scientific transfer evidence.
mechanics: Decode input to 4 low-to-high nibbles. For destination j, output nibble = (g_j * input[permutation[j]] + b_j) mod16, with g_3=1 and g_0..2 chosen from {1,3,5,7,9,11,13,15}. If relation flag=1 set output nibble0 ^= output nibble1. Decode by undoing XOR, odd modular inverses and inverse permutation. Exact bijection for all 65536 words.
learn: Enumerate 24 permutations and both gated-relation flags over FIT only. Per source-binding permutation and gate, transform observed output to ungated; for each of 4 output nibbles enumerate legal odd gains, infer most frequent residual bias from public FIT, then score candidate nibble FIT bit errors; sum four nibble errors. Select lexicographic minimum (error, relation-flag, permutation-index, encoded gains and biases). Compute second-best distinct candidate margin; abstain on any exact tie for best. No CHECK or source family tag in selection.
capacity: State 31 variable bits + reserved bit zero; unchanged native 7 active /9 retained. No extra persistent per-role table, no trained neural weights outside bitfield.
training_bound: Exactly 24*2*(8+8+8+1)*40=48000 residual samples for bias histogram and the same 48000 scored nibble samples, plus 40*4*24*2 chart? All training temporary data counted. 96,000 nibble operations before graph and CHECK.
acceptance: Freeze this candidate after implementation, then require independent F124-BV external original source births and exact old AZ, old BQ, trained BX, separately trained binding control in same public data/resource budget. No science claim from synthetic unit fixtures. Against strongest TRAINED control require >=5pp paired-positive transfer improvement on BOTH independently sealed 128-case novel cohorts with 0 hard FP, 0 accepted positive loss, and original source bound matched CPU+peak RSS nonregression. If cost exceeds strongest eligible trained control, fail regardless of accuracy.
zero_retrofit: Do not alter stage count, state width, sourceblind selection, fit/check thresholds, seeds, comparators or sample conditions after outcome; keep negatives.
